# Bundled font licences

The fonts in `src/rhr/vendor/pinevex/src/ui_engine/fonts/` retain their authors' copyright and licence terms. Their embedded metadata contains individual attribution; the licence texts are included here for redistribution. The repository's Apache-2.0 `LICENSE` covers the two Apache-licensed fonts.

- SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-1.1.txt`): Bangers, Creepster, FredokaOne-Regular, FredokaOne, Inconsolata, IndieFlower, Jura, Kalam, Merriweather, Montserrat (all five files), Nunito, Oswald, PatrickHand, PressStart2P (both files), Roboto, Sarpanch, SourceCodePro, SourceSansPro, TitilliumWeb.
- Apache License 2.0 (repository `LICENSE`): LuckiestGuy, PermanentMarker.
- Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0 (`UBUNTU-FONT-LICENCE-1.0.txt`): Ubuntu.
- Mozilla's [twemoji-colr](https://github.com/mozilla/twemoji-colr) project: TwemojiMozilla.ttf; font code under Apache-2.0, Twemoji artwork under CC BY 4.0 (`CC-BY-4.0.txt`). Artwork attribution: Twitter, Inc. and other contributors to [Twemoji](https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji); font packaging by Mozilla. No modifications to this font are claimed.

Sources for the texts: [SIL](https://software.sil.org/downloads/r/oflt/OFL.txt), [Canonical](https://assets.ubuntu.com/v1/81e5605d-ubuntu-font-licence-1.0.txt), [Creative Commons](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt). The project is not affiliated with these authors or licensors.
